messages:
Carmen R: Observing SSE mid-stream pauses (~7-9s) on the latest routing canary. No reconnects, but UIs spin. Anyone seen this after the keepalive change?
Vikram D: Yep, saw similar in eu-west-1. Trace shows payload -> ~8s silence -> payload. Matches probe TTL. Could be keepalive suppression during sticky-handoff.
Nate B: Can you paste a sanitized trace? Also include any edge ping logs if available.
Carmen R: trace (sanitized):
GET /v1/stream?model=redwood-lite
: 200 OK
data: {"delta":"A"}
... <8.1s silence> ...
data: {"delta":"B"}
Vikram D: 8.1s lines up. Console only shows socket OPEN/closed so PMs think sessions are healthy. We need a "last activity" field (last SSE or ping) surfaced in the console.
Nate B: Short-term: revert keepalive suppression on that canary and add an edge-emitted app-heartbeat on payload flush. Also sample raw byte timestamps for 0.1% sessions so console can show example traces.
Carmen R: Agree. Also add a console badge "stalled if last activity > 5s" so support can triage quickly.
infra-bot: Action created: infra/emit-app-heartbeat-and-sample -> canary eu-west-1. Also rollback job queued: revert/keepalive-suppression -> canary eu-west-1.
Vikram D: One more: add header x-graceful-restart when initiating handoff. Devex can ship a tiny SDK debounce to ignore reconnects <250ms if header present. That prevents duplicate work during drain windows.
Nate B: Sounds good. Will follow up after rollback and sample traces. Thanks :thumbsup:
